question.text: In a cuboid of dimension <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><mi>L</mi><mo>×</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>L</mi><mo>×</mo><mi>L</mi></math> , a charge <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>q</mi></math> is placed at the centre of the surface <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>S</mi></math> having area of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>4</mn><msup><mi>L</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></math> . The flux through the opposite surface to <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>S</mi></math> is given by

solution.text:
Assume a similar cuboid on top of the given cuboid to make symmetry about charge. Thus, it becomes a cube of length 2L.

Flux passing through whole cube is ϕ=q∈0(Gauss's Law).

Since, total faces are 6, so flux passing through shaded face =q6∈0.
